instruction:
GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Revit graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, Dynamo, pyRevit, macros, external API automation, Python, or any helper script/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only Revit native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, schedules, sheets, and built-in export commands. Start from a blank Revit project. Using the Revit GUI, model a pair of two-storey duplex townhouses with an overall rectangular footprint of 18.0 m by 9.6 m near the project origin. The exterior wall envelope should rise about 6.2 m over two storeys, include ground and upper slabs, and have a roof covering the full footprint above the second storey. Provide two stairs that connect the lower and upper storeys near the middle/rear of the plan. Save the deliverables on the Desktop using the exact filenames required below.

The IFC export must use the IFC4 schema, have unique GlobalId values for all IfcRoot objects, and contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, two IfcBuildingStorey entities, ten IfcSpace entities, sixteen IfcWall entities, two IfcSlab entities, one IfcRoof, ten IfcDoor entities, eight IfcWindow entities, and two IfcStair entities. Do not include IfcColumn, IfcBeam, IfcCurtainWall, or IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. Name the spaces so the normalized IfcSpace names include at least two living spaces, two kitchens, four bedrooms, and two baths. Export a two-page Revit plan sheet PDF named result.pdf; its sheet text must include A101 LEVEL 1 PLAN, A102 LEVEL 2 PLAN, Bedroom 1 A, and Bedroom 2 B. The required BIM categories must be exported as real IFC building elements/spaces, not visual-only placeholders or proxy geometry. Coordinate placement, relationship entities, GUID values, Revit type names, materials, property sets, and harmless extra metadata may vary as long as the stated model geometry, element categories, space names, schedules, sheets, and file outputs are satisfied.
